title: What does Payment do on XRPL?
abstract: Sourced explanation of Payment and its practical limits.
body:
According to XRPL documentation, Payment transfers value on XRPL and can also exchange assets along a payment path. [1]

Only XRP payments can fund a new account. For an incoming payment, inspect validated delivered_amount rather than trusting the requested maximum: partial-payment semantics can deliver less. Currency and issuer identify an issued asset together. Destination tags route hosted customers but do not create separate ledger accounts. [1]

The Payment reference defines the operation-specific fields alongside the shared XRPL transaction fields. Account identifies the submitting account; signing authority, transaction cost and sequence handling still have to satisfy the ledger rules. A submitted transaction or an example in documentation does not establish a successful validated result. Where an amendment is required, confirm it is enabled on the intended network before relying on the feature. [1][2]

Author interpretation: before using Payment, compare the intended change with the current ledger state and keep the transaction hash with the resulting metadata. Treat unresolved outcomes as unresolved; submitting a replacement operation can create a second obligation. These are integration recommendations, not a report of a live test. Sources accessed 10 November 2026.
